chunks.arabic_text: أَيُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ يُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ لِنَفْسِهِ فِي أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ أَوْ يُؤَخِّرُ قَلِيلًا وَيُصَلِّي بِأَهْلِ مَسْجِدِهِ إِذَا كَانَ إِمَامَهُمْ

translations.en: Which of the two is better: that a man performs salat (prayer) by himself at the beginning of the time, or that he delay a little and perform salat (prayer) with the people of his mosque if he is their Imam?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «يُؤَخِّرُ وَيُصَلِّي بِأَهْلِ مَسْجِدِهِ إِذَا كَانَ هُوَ الْإِمَامَ.

translations.en: He (عليه السلام) said: "He should delay and perform salat (prayer) with the people of his mosque if he is the Imam."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the virtue of congregational salat (prayer) when a person serves as the Imam of his mosque. It indicates that delaying slightly in order to lead the congregation is better than praying alone at the earliest time.
en.seo_question: Is it better for the Imam to pray at the beginning of the time alone or delay slightly to lead congregational salat (prayer)?

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous or preferable in practice
key_terms.أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ: the beginning of the prescribed prayer time
key_terms.بِأَهْلِ مَسْجِدِهِ: with the people of his mosque in congregation
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the one leading the congregational salat (prayer)
